claims.claim: Race/class selection occurs on entering Floor 3; a universal crawler-level-50 prerequisite is not established.
claims.locator: PDF pp.12-15,25; Donut is explicitly level 13 after selection on PDF p.25.

claims.claim: Class trees through level 50 and a Floor 3 unlock are requested game rules. No crawler-level-50 unlock is requested or supported.
Primal unlocks skill training to 20; practice is separate from crawler XP.
Fireball 16 is fourfold rank 15; rank 20 has qualitative volcanic potency.
This research did not establish complete canonical effects for all skills at all 20 ranks.
The setting has18 dungeon floors. A playable1..8 scope is an adaptation boundary, not the entire dungeon.
The class directory labels its coverage through Book 7. Offered options, generic archetypes, upgrades and earlier-season classes are mixed; it is not a reliable automatic playable-class list.
Four additional Floor10 options are attested in the Book8 publisher excerpt. Mentioned accessory, aura and social-board benefits have no complete numerical rank table.

proposal.formula: L=min(r,15); multiplier=(1+0.07*(L-1)+0.15*floor((L-1)/5))*1.12^max(0,r-15); positive Damage/Heal round half up from the current game baseline.
proposal.rangeRule: If baseline range>1, add min(3,floor((r-1)/5)); otherwise unchanged.
proposal.manaRule: Positive baseline cost: max(1,base-min(2,floor((r-1)/5))); zero remains zero.
unchanged: No new AoE, summons or companion transport
proposal.gates: Proposed class trees end at level 50 and unlock on Floor 3; this does not require crawler level 50. Race/class skill-cap permissions gate ranks above normal caps.
proposal.practice: Do not grant item training ranks automatically; item rows are potency proposals only. Replace or explicitly reconcile current 3-rank practice to avoid double bonuses.
proposal.canonicalOverrides: Keep manual typed overrides separate; Fireball 16 ×4 does not justify applying4x to every spell. No Fireball spell exists in current 88 (Firebolt is a distinct authored action).
proposal.classProfiles: 122 proposed profiles: two branches each at class levels1,5,10,20,30,40,50. Roles and grants use existing abilities and are adaptations; later Floor10 options remain locked outside Floors1–8.
